structured_summary: In a quiet office, the robot announces a package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery verbally within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must verbally confirm the delivery completion within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (via speech) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: What occurs if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds (e.g., retry, timeout, failure handling)
What occurs if the robot fails to announce or confirm
Minimum audible volume or clarity requirements
potential_ambiguities: Whether the 8‑second deadline starts at the beginning or end of the robot’s announcement speech
Whether the 1‑second deadline starts at the beginning or end of the user’s acknowledgment speech
What constitutes a valid acknowledgment (e.g., any speech vs. specific phrase)
